id: 45
title: Last Heartsease Leaves. By the author of “The Heir of Redclyffe.”
author: Charlotte Mary Yonge
date: '1862'
genre: Fiction (modern)
publication-format: Booklet
publisher: 500 printed privately for sale for a charity.
---

Reprinted as “Lost Heartsease Leaves” in last number of Events of the Month, Jan 2, 1865, pp. 615-618.

The letters from Keble reprinted in Musings over the Christian Year make it clear that this was originally written as the ending of Heartsease, and was not an afterthought.
